Magna Scavell of the Order of Tirisfal was the Guardian for several centuries, starting around more than a millennium prior to the First War. When the time to retire from his century of guardianship came, he discovered that there were no suitable replacements to take his place. As such he reluctantly agreed to remain as Guardian. Over Scavell's long guardianship he and the council would keep a strong relationship as they continued to protect the world from the Legion. In particular he would consider Erbag and Relfthra, the gnomish and high elven representatives to the council, among his closest friends. The Scarlet Watch Post (or Crusader's Run) is a scout tower located in northeastern Tirisfal Glades, just north of the Scarlet Monastery. Its maintenance despite its remote location is solely to prevent enemies of the Scarlet Crusade from assaulting the monastery from its less defensible north side. It's one of the four Crusader's Outpost towers in Tirisfal Glades. This particular tower is commanded by Captain Melrache. After the Cataclysm, Lilian Voss arrived here and killed Melrache and her father, High Priest Benedictus Voss.

The Scarshield Legion is a division of Rend Blackhand's Blackrock orcs that reside primarily in the lower levels of Blackrock Spire, where they breed and train attack worgs. They are the gatekeepers to the inner sanctum of Lower Blackrock Spire.

__NOTOC__ Scarlet Troopers are human paladins that spawn and escort . When a player accepts the quest The Scarlet Oracle, Demetria, she and eight Scarlet Troopers will spawn in Tyr's Hand. They follow a fixed path through Corin's Crossing, still walking on the path, to the Plaguewoods, and finally to Stratholme where they will despawn. Scarlet Troopers are not to be taken lightly and are in fact some of the tougher non-elites in the game. Demetria will rez them if they are killed before her, so don't bother with them until Demtria is dead. The Troopers along with Demetria will attack all undead or hostile enemies they encounter, including player characters.

Scenarios, introduced in Mists of Pandaria, are short, 3-player instances, with progressive objectives and a story arc. Scenarios are completely role-less, meaning tanks or healers aren't necessary to succeed - any class combination can work. Smaller scenarios play similar to group quests and help players earn faction reputation, while larger scenarios play out like epic PvE battlegrounds with major objectives and plenty of scripted events. They are instanced areas. Scenarios are available at level 90. Most scenarios have a minimum average item level of 425 in order to queue for them. Scarlet Renegades were former members of the Scarlet Crusade who have openly rebelled against the order as renegades. They accompanied Joseph the Awakened throughout all sections of the Scarlet Monastery.

The Scarlet renegades, led by Joseph the Awakened, are rebels of the Scarlet Crusade. They seek to reform the order after having realized the evil corruption of the Crusade. The Renegades seek redemption after the actions of the Crusade and have thus aligned themselves with the Alliance. They ask for their aid to seize control of the Crusade. After the Scarlet Monastery's quest chain, the renegades' coup d'état is a success but the organization's leadership has unfortunately fallen into insanity.

The Scepter of Rebirth is the objective of The Last Witch Doctor of Krag'wa in Nazmir.
Scavenger's Drape never made it out of the Mists of Pandaria beta.
The Scepter of the Azsh'ari drops from Abyssal Commander Sivara in the Eternal Palace.
Scavenger's Barrier was to be rewarded from Saving Snowpuff.
__NOTOC__ Scavenging Dunerunners are hyenas located in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum.
Scavenge-bot 004-A8 are crowd pummelers located in the Borean Tundra that seem to belong to Gearmaster Mechazod. They are made to scavenge the remains used for robots around the Geyser Fields.
The Scavenger's Shore is a beach controlled by naga in Stormsong Valley. They are holding several tortollan prisoners.
Scarred Fathomjaws are threshadons located in Zuldazar and Stormsong Valley.
Scattering Grubbers are saurid located on the Blood Coast and Torga's Rest in Nazmir.
Scavenge like a Vulpera is a quest achievement earned by completing a digsite while dressed like a vulpera during the Vol'dun Assault World Quest Vulpera for a Day.
Scent of the Sea is a profession achievement earned by converting 100 fish from Kul Tiras and Zandalar into Aromatic fish Oil.
Scavenging Bonetusks are bloodtusks located in the Forgotten Wounds in Maldraxxus.
The Scepter of the Wild Hunt is purchased for from Mar'lan at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.
The Scattered Bones are left behind when infusing the Rib-Bone Choker of Dominance into the Heart Forge.
Scavenging Crawlers are sand reavers located in the Ruins of the First Bastion in Gorgrond.
Scavenging Soul Eaters are soul eaters located in the Beastwarrens in the Maw.
Scavenging Mawrats are mawrats located in the Planes of Torment during the Escape from the Maw.
Scavenged Souls are souls located in the Maw. They can be saved, and will bestow a Grateful Blessing on the adventurer, increasing their maximum health by 10% for 10 minutes.
Scavenger Bajard is a Maldraxxi skeleton located at Keres' Rest in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ The Scenery Chewing Gorm is a gorm located in Dominance Keep of Revendreth.

Scavenging Razorwings are razorwings located in the central crossroads of Korthia between Seeker's Quorum and the Mauler's Outlook. While players are feeding Hungry Gromits on Think of the Critters, the scavengers may pop out of nowhere to attack!
Scavenging Skrats are skrat critters located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.
Schematic: A-N0M-A-L0U5 Orthogonal Optics teaches how to create A-N0M-A-L0U5 Orthogonal Optics.
Schematic: A-N0M-A-L0U5 Bionic Bifocals teaches how to create A-N0M-A-L0U5 Bionic Bifocals.
Scarred Bloodbound Girdle drops from Domina Venomblade in Plaguefall.
Scarred Battleboar Breastplate is a quest reward from The Battleboars (2).
Scavenger Vest is a quest reward from Scourge on our Perimeter.
